concat_datapipes: concatenate multiple IterDataPipes to yield all elements from each in sequence
fork_datapipe_branches: fork a single IterDataPipe into multiple child branches sharing a common buffer
demux_datapipe_with_classifier: demultiplex an IterDataPipe into multiple child DataPipes using a classification function
mux_datapipes_round_robin: multiplex multiple IterDataPipes yielding one element at a time from each in round-robin order
zip_datapipes_into_tuples: zip multiple IterDataPipes to aggregate elements into tuples until the shortest is exhausted
